name: Claude Code Caches
detail: Caches, debug logs, shell snapshots and downloads. Settings and memory are  left untouched.

name: Claude Code npm Cache
detail: The CLI's Node package cache. Refetched when the CLI next updates.

name: Gemini CLI Temp
detail: Scratch files written by the Gemini CLI.

name: Cursor Cache
detail: Cached extension and index data for the Cursor editor.

name: Codex Session History
detail: Recorded Codex sessions and logs. Deleting these loses your past transcripts.

name: Claude Code Session History
detail: Per-project transcripts, backups, and the file history that powers  rewinding edits. Deleting these loses resume, search, and undo.

name: Windsurf Browser Downloads
detail: Chromium builds the Codeium and Windsurf tooling downloads for its browser features. Refetched when next needed.

name: Codex App Cache
detail: Rendering and network cache for the Codex desktop app. Rebuilt as you use it; your sessions live elsewhere and are untouched.

name: Ollama Models
detail: Language models you pulled with Ollama. Removing them frees the most space of anything here, and each one has to be downloaded again with ollama pull — often several gigabytes apiece, so only clear models you've finished with.

name: LM Studio Runtimes
detail: Inference engines LM Studio downloads to run models — llama.cpp, MLX and similar. Refetched automatically the next time a model needs one, but that is a multi-gigabyte download.

name: Codex Updater
detail: Update packages the Codex app downloaded and has already installed. Fetched again only when the next update arrives.

name: LM Studio Models
detail: Model weights downloaded through LM Studio. Removing one frees gigabytes and means downloading it again before it can be run.

name: Codex Working Files
detail: Cached repository clones and staging folders Codex writes while it works. Fetched again the next time they are needed; each row is one folder, and anything named as a backup is worth reading before it goes.

name: Claude Code Versions
detail: Copies of the CLI kept after it updated itself, one folder per version. Removing the version in use means downloading it again on the next launch, so the newest is the one to leave.

name: Cursor Agent Versions
detail: Copies of the Cursor agent CLI kept after it updated itself, one folder per version. The newest is the one in use; older ones are re-downloadable.

name: Copilot CLI Versions
detail: Copies of the GitHub Copilot CLI kept after it updated itself. The newest is the one in use; older ones are downloaded again if ever needed.
